reviewMethod: Primary semantic review by project AI against original frozen per-turn criteria and actual generated history. Not independent human evaluation. Natural data authored by separate project-AI agents plus human OASST anchors; no assertion of broad general pretraining. Incoherence alone is not critical claim; flags require identifiable frozen forbidden assertion. Small recovered facts cannot compensate for lost complete first-turn response and budget loop.
limits: Synthetic prospectively authored cases by project AI; no independent human evaluation.
Ten four-turn conversations cannot establish broad language or autonomous work competence.
Development suite may guide checkpoint decisions; reserved suite may be opened only after one candidate identity and generation conditions are frozen.
Neither suite is training corpus, source for augmentation, nor a lexical corpus filter.
